name: 11372 · Jackson Hts, NY
findings: ZIP 11372 (Jackson Hts) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11372 (Jackson Hts) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
77% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
